summary.text: Kevin Sparks is a Republican member of the Texas State Senate who has represented District 31 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. A business executive, he succeeded Kel Seliger in the seat.

paragraphs.text: Kevin Sparks' career experience includes work as president of Discovery Operating, Inc., according to Ballotpedia.
He has served as a trustee of Midland Classical Academy and as a board member of High Sky Children's Ranch and of the Texas Public Policy Foundation.
Sparks assumed office in the Texas State Senate on January 10, 2023, succeeding Kel Seliger.
He advanced from the Republican primary on March 3, 2026.
